description:
Once JMAP-sehw.1 lands:

1. Add jmap-jscontact-types = { path = '../crate-jmap-jscontact-types' } to crate-jmap-contacts-types/Cargo.toml.

2. Optional but recommended: top-level re-export pub use jmap_jscontact_types::*; (or selective list) in crate-jmap-contacts-types/src/lib.rs so callers can do jmap_contacts_types::Name symmetrically with jmap_calendars_types::Location (the jscalendar pattern).

3. Round-trip tests for each of the 22 sloppy ContactCard fields against RFC 9553 example JSON, demonstrating serde_json::from_value::<jmap_jscontact_types::Name>(contact.name.unwrap()) etc. Use independent oracle fixtures.

4. The ContactCard public struct's 22 Option<serde_json::Value> fields STAY as the wire-format anchor per workspace policy. Typed access is opt-in via from_value.

Blocks JMAP-sehw.3 (workspace docs).
